title: 第322章 另一个故事中第321章 另一个故事上
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 她对她说：“你不能成仙。”
陈清月思索片刻，抬眼问道：“为什么？”
如果没记错的话，自己应该和她无冤无仇，就算有仇，也应该算在王易的身上。
陈忱眨眨眼睛，说：“成仙不是什么好事儿，我以前是个仙人，现在也不干了。”
陈清月不太清楚陈忱究竟是什么来历。
她只是心里有些好奇和疑惑，一个外人是怎么神不知鬼不觉混进水牛镇的。
陈忱说：“有人带路。”
陈清月问是谁？
“你也认识。”
是许青禾带的路，她把一个外人引来了小镇。
陈清月叹了口气，问：“她不想我成仙？”
陈忱摇了摇头，说：“那倒没有，她没说过这话。”
许青禾对前世今生分的很清，前世的恩怨与自己无关，今生她有自己的事要忙。
陈清月安静片刻，又问：“那你为什么不希望我成仙呢？”
陈忱正色说道：“成仙没什么前途。”
“仙路将断，就算你在这里成了仙也不会长久。”
小镇一片寂静，陈忱轻声细语，说了很多话。
陈清月默默听着，表情莫名，眼神闪烁不停。
过了很长时间，小镇快要天亮了，陈清月才勉强接受了这些信息。
说实在的，她仿佛听了一个漫长且离奇的故事，很多故事情节都让人难以置信，不知该作何反应。
“我凭什么相信你？”
陈忱想了想，说：“我上辈子是山上人。”
是叛下山的二河主。
“所以呢？”
“所以，世上没有几个人比我更了解那座山，没什么人比我更了解山主。”
陈忱说：“如果我说的都是谎话，那我大可以继续在山上作仙人，完全没有必要将自己置于死地，冒这个风险。”
这个理由听起来令人信服。
陈清月思索片刻，问她：“你知道什么，找到了什么？”
“我知道，山上的人越来越少，山上的树越来越老。”
山主早就离开了那座山，山上已经没剩下几个活人了。
所以，她也走了。
二河主趁着山上没人，溜溜达达的跑下了山，她想去很多地方看看，想瞧瞧世间莲花都开在哪里。
但没多久，大河主回到了山上，满腔愤怒，从天涯追到了海角。
陈清月问：“不是山主的意思？”
陈忱摇摇头：“山主其实没回来，是大河不愿意放过我。”
“为什么？”
“我把祂这么多年攒下来的家底都撬走了，掏的一干二净，一点儿都没留。”
“我还把这些东西丢在了路上，走到哪儿就洒在哪儿，祂像狗一样东奔西走，跟在后面捡食吃。”
content_en:
She said to her: "You cannot become an immortal."
Chen Qingyue thought for a moment, raised her eyes and asked, "Why?"
If I remember correctly, I should have no enmity or enmity with her. Even if I have enmity, it should be attributed to Wang Yi.
Chen Chen blinked his eyes and said, "Becoming an immortal is not a good thing. I used to be an immortal, but I don't want to be an immortal anymore."
Chen Qingyue wasn't quite sure where Chen Chen came from.
She was just a little curious and confused about how an outsider sneaked into Buffalo Town without anyone noticing.
Chen Chen said: "Someone will lead the way."
Chen Qingyue asked who it was?
"You know him too."
It was Xu Qinghe who led the way. She led an outsider to the small town.
Chen Qingyue sighed and asked, "She doesn't want me to become an immortal?"
Chen Chen shook his head and said, "That's not true. She never said that."
Xu Qinghe made a clear distinction between the past and present lives. The grudges in her past life had nothing to do with her. She had her own things to be busy with in this life.
Chen Qingyue was quiet for a moment and then asked: "Then why don't you want me to become an immortal?"
Chen Chen said seriously: "There is no future for becoming an immortal."
"The road to immortality will be cut off. Even if you become an immortal here, it won't last long."
The town was silent, Chen Chen whispered and said a lot.
Chen Qingyue listened silently, with an incomprehensible expression and eyes flickering.
After a long time, it was almost dawn in the town, and Chen Qingyue reluctantly accepted the information.
To be honest, she seemed to have heard a long and bizarre story. Many of the storylines were unbelievable and she didn't know how to react.
"Why should I trust you?"
Chen Chen thought for a while and said, "I was a mountain person in my previous life."
It was the Lord of Erhe who rebelled down the mountain.
"So?"
"So, there are few people in the world who know that mountain better than me, and no one knows the owner of the mountain better than me."
Chen Chen said: "If everything I told is a lie, then I can continue to be an immortal on the mountain. There is no need to put myself to death and take this risk."
This reason sounds convincing.
Chen Qingyue thought for a moment and asked her: "What do you know and what did you find?"
"I know that there are fewer and fewer people on the mountain, and the trees on the mountain are getting older and older."
The mountain owner had left the mountain long ago, and there were not many living people left on the mountain.
So, she left too.
Lord Erhe took advantage of the fact that there was no one on the mountain and ran down the mountain. She wanted to see many places and where the lotus flowers were blooming in the world.
But not long after, the Great River Lord returned to the mountain, filled with anger, and chased him from the end of the world to the end of the sea.
Chen Qingyue asked: "Isn't that what the mountain master meant?"
Chen Chen shook his head: "The mountain master actually didn't come back, it's because Dahe didn't want to let me go."
"Why?"
"I took away all the wealth that He had accumulated over the years. I took everything out and left nothing behind."
"..."
"I also left these things on the road and scattered them wherever I went. He ran around like a dog, following behind to pick up food."
"..."
